title: Replication Package: Evolutionary history from genomes to single cells by lossless compression
description: Complete self-contained source code, curated/assembled empirical and simulated alignments, single-cell somatic cohorts, precomputed benchmark ledgers, automated verification harnesses, figure generators, and LaTeX manuscript sources for Bushwhacker (MDL evolutionary tree and lateral network inference).
